entities.summary: Bikutsi is a musical genre from Cameroon. It developed from the traditional styles of the Beti, or Ewondo, people, who live around the city of Yaoundé. It was popular in the middle of the 20th century in West Africa. It is primarily dance music. bikutsi is a music genre, created circa 1940. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
